title: The motel application, ii
logline: Tuesday. The form. Wood fills it in the display face, the one from the flyers, because it's the only hand he has that looks like a person's. EXPERIENCE: a long blank.

panels.composition: The garage. A one-page application on the drafting table. WOOD with a pen. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man at a drafting table filling in a one-page job application with a pen, an old dog beneath

panels.composition: The form. NAME, in flawless display capitals: ARTHUR FINCH. The rest in the same face. It looks like a poster.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a job application filled in with immaculate hand-lettered display capitals so it looks like a poster
image.notes: Letter after: ARTHUR FINCH in the flyer face. The author's name, written by the character, in the strip's hand.

panels.composition: EXPERIENCE: ______. The pen hovering. The dog's chin on the table edge.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a blank experience field on a form with a pen hovering and an old dog's chin resting on the table edge

panels.composition: Wood writing, small, in the blank: 'I'm awake at night anyway.' Then crossing it out. Then writing it again.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man writing a short line on a form, crossing it out, and writing it again
image.notes: Letter after: 'I'm awake at night anyway.' twice, the first struck through.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: ARTHUR FINCH in the display face. 'I'm awake at night anyway.'
